title: TAI dual preflight activation dispatch authority
objective: Allow restricted Qwen activation to consume only an exact-main successful TAI Automatic REG.RU Preflight workflow_run or an exact-main successful owner-issued TAI Owner REG.RU Preflight, while preserving deterministic dispatch, protected activation, acceptance, rollback and deployment gates.
boundaries: Activation remains workflow_dispatch-only and never listens directly to issue_comment or workflow_run
The activation dispatch actor and triggering actor must be the repository owner or github-actions[bot]
Activation accepts exactly one of two upstream authorities: TAI Automatic REG.RU Preflight or TAI Owner REG.RU Preflight
Both upstream authorities must be terminal successful, exact current-main SHA, exact run attempt and prove the same six successful preflight jobs
Automatic upstream authority must be event workflow_run on branch main with owner-or-github-actions actor and triggering actor
Owner upstream authority must be event issue_comment with repository owner as actor and triggering actor
The manual /tai activate current-main command remains owner-only and selects its upstream run from the exact successful TAI REG.RU Preflight commit status
All exact image, protected REG.RU controller, RU/EN/ZH SSE, potato, Chromium, rollback, finalization and deployment gates remain unchanged
No direct production SSH, Docker authority, tenant, role, model admission, financial or write authority is widened
